name: Emilia Anomla
source:
Master of Summon Spirit Axos and a Gravesister within the GraveKeepers Society. A veteran GraveKeeper whose hard-headedness and rash nature often prove her own worst enemies, despite her fierce strength and potent Divine Force Projection.

First appearance: GraveKeeper Academy
